inlines.v: TEN'DER-HE'ARTED, adjective [tender and heart.] 1. Having great sensibility; susceptible of impressions or influence. --When Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them. 2 Chronicles 13:7. 2. Very susceptible of the softer passions of love, pity or kindness. Be ye kind one to another, and tender-hearted Ephesians 4:32.
